reply.text:
Most research on lifters lands around 0.7 to 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight per day (roughly 1.6 to 2.2 g per kg). Going higher than that doesn't hurt, but it rarely adds much. Past the daily total, spreading it across 3 or 4 meals tends to work better than cramming it all into one.

That's a general range, not a target for you. If you want one built around your weight and goal, I can have the app work it out. For anything medical, like kidney issues, check with a doctor or dietitian first.
